overall: The AG found no violation: the selection committee was created by the Town Administrator to advise him on a matter he alone decided, so under Connelly it was not a public body subject to the OML.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board created a property-review selection committee by an unnoticed vote, so the committee had to comply with the OML.
allegations.key_passage: Accordingly, we find that the Town Administrator created the selection committee to assist him with the task of evaluating proposals.
